_comment: Brand pack manifest. Copy to brand/brand.json (gitignored) and fill it in; workflows/brand.md walks through it. Keys starting with _ are notes. Delete a key to keep Lore's default for it.
name: <Company or org name>

titles._comment: Optional. Rename Lore's surfaces in the brand's plain voice. Lore stays credited: keep 'by Lore' in a subtitle.

charts._comment: Optional. Colors for charts drawn with design-system/charts/chart-theme.js. Each color: main, deep, soft.

sources._comment: Where the brand came from, so a refresh knows where to look.
sources.fonts: <where the font files came from and their license>
